cards.name: Bulbasaur
cards.description: There is a plant seed on its back right from the day this Pokémon is born. The seed slowly grows larger.

cards.name: Ivysaur
cards.description: When the bulb on its back grows large, it appears to lose the ability to stand on its hind legs.

cards.name: Venusaur
cards.description: Its plant blooms when it is absorbing solar energy. It stays on the move to seek sunlight.

cards.name: Radiant Venusaur
cards.description: Its plant blooms when it is absorbing solar energy. It stays on the move to seek sunlight.

cards.name: Spinarak
cards.description: Although the poison from its fangs isn't that strong, it's potent enough to weaken prey that gets caught in its web.

cards.name: Ariados
cards.description: It spews threads from its mouth to catch its prey. When night falls, it leaves its web to go hunt aggressively.

cards.name: Charmander
cards.description: It has a preference for hot things. When it rains, steam is said to spout from the tip of its tail.

cards.name: Charmeleon
cards.description: It has a barbaric nature. In battle, it whips its fiery tail around and slashes away with sharp claws.

cards.name: Charizard
cards.description: It spits fire that is hot enough to melt boulders. It may cause forest fires by blowing flames.

cards.name: Radiant Charizard
cards.description: It spits fire that is hot enough to melt boulders. It may cause forest fires by blowing flames.

cards.name: Moltres
cards.description: It's one of the legendary bird Pokémon. When Moltres flaps its flaming wings, they glimmer with a dazzling red glow.

cards.name: Numel
cards.description: The magma in its body reaches 2,200 degrees Fahrenheit. Its hump gets smaller when it uses Fire-type moves.

cards.name: Camerupt
cards.description: If angered, the humps on its back erupt in a shower of molten lava. It lives in the craters of volcanoes.

cards.name: Squirtle
cards.description: When it retracts its long neck into its shell, it squirts out water with vigorous force.

cards.name: Wartortle
cards.description: It is recognized as a symbol of longevity. If its shell has algae on it, that Wartortle is very old.

cards.name: Blastoise
cards.description: It crushes its foe under its heavy body to cause fainting. In a pinch, it will withdraw inside its shell.

cards.name: Radiant Blastoise
cards.description: It crushes its foe under its heavy body to cause fainting. In a pinch, it will withdraw inside its shell.

cards.name: Slowpoke
cards.description: Slow-witted and oblivious, this Pokémon won't feel any pain if its tail gets eaten. It won't notice when its tail grows back, either.

cards.name: Slowbro
cards.description: Slowpoke became Slowbro when a Shellder bit on to its tail. Sweet flavors seeping from the tail make the Shellder feel as if its life is a dream.

cards.name: Magikarp
cards.description: It is virtually worthless in terms of both power and speed. It is the most weak and pathetic Pokémon in the world.

cards.name: Gyarados
cards.description: It has an extremely aggressive nature. The Hyper Beam it shoots from its mouth totally incinerates all targets.

cards.name: Lapras
cards.description: A smart and kindhearted Pokémon, it glides across the surface of the sea while its beautiful song echoes around it.

cards.name: Articuno
cards.description: It's said that this Pokémon's beautiful blue wings are made of ice. Articuno flies over snowy mountains, its long tail fluttering along behind it.

cards.name: Wimpod
cards.description: It's nature's cleaner—it eats anything and everything, including garbage and rotten things. The ground near its nest is always clean.

cards.name: Golisopod
cards.description: It will do anything to win, taking advantage of every opening and finishing opponents off with the small claws on its front legs.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.description: Pikachu that can generate powerful electricity have cheek sacs that are extra soft and super stretchy.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.description: Pikachu that can generate powerful electricity have cheek sacs that are extra soft and super stretchy.

cards.name: Zapdos
cards.description: This Pokémon has complete control over electricity. There are tales of Zapdos nesting in the dark depths of pitch-black thunderclouds.

cards.name: Natu
cards.description: It is extremely good at climbing tree trunks and likes to eat the new sprouts on the trees.

cards.name: Xatu
cards.description: They say that it stays still and quiet because it is seeing both the past and future at the same time.

cards.name: Lunatone
cards.description: The phase of the moon apparently has some effect on its power. It's active on the night of a full moon.

cards.name: Sylveon
cards.description: By releasing enmity-erasing waves from its ribbonlike feelers, Sylveon stops any conflict.

cards.name: Onix
cards.description: As it digs through the ground, it absorbs many hard objects. This is what makes its body so solid.

cards.name: Larvitar
cards.description: Born deep underground, it comes aboveground and becomes a pupa once it has finished eating the surrounding soil.

cards.name: Pupitar
cards.description: Even sealed in its shell, it can move freely. Hard and fast, it has outstanding destructive power.

cards.name: Solrock
cards.description: When it rotates itself, it gives off light similar to the sun, thus blinding its foes.

cards.name: Alolan Rattata
cards.description: Night after night, they sneak into people's homes seeking food. A massive outbreak of them has become an issue of public concern.

cards.name: Alolan Raticate
cards.description: It commands a nest of Rattata. Different nests don't get along, whipping up severe fights over feeding grounds.

cards.name: Tyranitar
cards.description: Its body can't be harmed by any sort of attack, so it is very eager to make challenges against enemies.

cards.name: Steelix
cards.description: It is said that if an Onix lives for over 100 years, its composition changes to become diamond-like.

cards.name: Meltan
cards.description: It melts particles of iron and other metals found in the subsoil, so it can absorb them into its body of molten steel.

cards.name: Melmetal
cards.description: Revered long ago for its capacity to create iron from nothing, for some reason it has come back to life after 3,000 years.

cards.name: Chansey
cards.description: The egg Chansey carries is not only delicious but also packed with nutrition. It's used as a high-class cooking ingredient.

cards.name: Blissey
cards.description: Whenever a Blissey finds a weakened Pokémon, it will share its egg and offer its care until the other Pokémon is all better.

cards.name: Ditto
cards.description: It can reconstitute its entire cellular structure to change into what it sees, but it returns to normal when it relaxes.

cards.name: Eevee
cards.description: It has the ability to alter the composition of its body to suit its surrounding environment.

cards.name: Snorlax
cards.description: It is not satisfied unless it eats over 880 pounds of food every day. When it is done eating, it goes promptly to sleep.

cards.name: Aipom
cards.description: It searches for prey from the tops of trees. When it spots its favorite food, Bounsweet, Aipom gets excited and pounces.

cards.name: Ambipom
cards.description: It uses its tails for everything. If it wraps both of its tails around you and gives you a squeeze, that's proof it really likes you.

cards.name: Bidoof
cards.description: It constantly gnaws on logs and rocks to whittle down its front teeth. It nests alongside water.

cards.name: Bibarel
cards.description: It makes its nest by damming streams with bark and mud. It is known as an industrious worker.

cards.name: Pidove
cards.description: Where people go, these Pokémon follow. If you're scattering food for them, be careful— several hundred of them can gather at once.

cards.name: Tranquill
cards.description: It can fly moderately quickly. No matter how far it travels, it can always find its way back to its master and its nest.

cards.name: Unfezant
cards.description: Unfezant are exceptional fliers. The females are known for their stamina, while the males outclass them in terms of speed.
